review.headline: 45-min easy ride completed as prescribed, with heart rate well inside easy range.
observations: Rode 23.5 km in 2760 s (46 min), matching the 45-min easy spin plan.
Average HR 126 (max 134), well below the 140 easy-run average, so intensity stayed at RPE 4 or below.
Ride replaced easy running volume on a day after the 6 km tempo cut short on 11-10, which supports recovery.
